plugins.name: motion-launch-videos
plugins.description: Eight skills for short looping launch videos made in code: kinetic type, flat shapes, cartoons, 3D type and logos, data charts, pixel art, particles and app UI. Each film is one self-contained HTML file driven by a pure seek(t), rendered to MP4 with real motion blur and a verified seamless loop.
